name: Front Squat
current_title: HOW TO FRONT SQUAT: Build Bigger Quads & A Stronger Squat
problems: 9-min Jeff Nippard video, long for a form check; "This keeps the bar secure and your spine stacked" is filler
current_cue: Elbows high, chest proud. This keeps the bar secure and your spine stacked. Push the floor away to stand. Heel-elevated shoes help if ankles are tight.
proposed_title: How To Front Squat (HIGHER ELBOWS!)
proposed_cue: Bar on the front of the shoulders, elbows high. Sit straight down between the hips, then stand up through the whole foot.
proposed_tips: Fingertips under the bar are enough; a full grip is not needed. | If the elbows drop, the bar rolls forward. Lift the elbows first out of the bottom. | Small plates under the heels help if the ankles are tight.
coach_hint: Your main squat. Goblet squats in weeks 1-2, front squat from week 3. Sets of 8 with 2-3 reps left; your squat max is worked out from these sets.

name: Bench Press
current_title: How To Get A Huge Bench Press with Perfect Technique
problems: 12-min video; "like you are holding a pencil" and "builds a stronger press" are stock phrases
current_cue: Squeeze shoulder blades together like you're holding a pencil. This protects your shoulders and builds a stronger press. Drive feet into the floor. Bar touches mid-chest.
proposed_title: How To Bench Press With PERFECT Form
proposed_cue: Shoulder blades back and down, feet flat. Lower the bar to the lower chest, then press it back up over the shoulders.
proposed_tips: Grip so the forearms are vertical at the bottom. | Touch the chest lightly, no bounce. | Keep the butt on the bench.
coach_hint: Main press. 2-3 hard sets, RPE 6-7 early in Block Zero, never to failure.

name: Overhead Press
current_title: Build Bigger Shoulders With Perfect Training Technique (The Overhead Press)
problems: 8-min Jeff Nippard video, long
current_cue: Ribs down, squeeze glutes. This locks your core into a strong brace position. Bar starts at collarbone, press straight up. Head moves through at the top.
proposed_title: CORRECT STARTING POSITION FOR THE PRESS (Standing Overhead)
proposed_cue: Bar on the front of the shoulders, grip just outside them. Squeeze the glutes, press straight up and move the head through once the bar passes it.
proposed_tips: Ribs down. Do not lean back to finish the rep. | Lock out with the bar over the middle of the foot. | On a sore-back day the coach swaps in the DB press.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase press. Builds shoulder strength for the guard and clinch. Swapped for DB press when back today is 2 or lower.

name: Bent Over Row
current_title: "How To" Barbell Row
problems: Video is 12 years old; Alan Thrall has a newer version
current_cue: Hinge at the hips, flat back, brace. Pull the weight to the lower chest, squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top, then lower under control. You should feel the upper and middle back working, not the low back. Builds upper-back strength.
proposed_title: How To Barbell Row
proposed_cue: Hinge until the torso is near 45 degrees, back flat. Pull the bar to the lower ribs, pause, lower it under control.
proposed_tips: Brace before every rep, not just the first. | If the torso rises to finish the rep, the weight is too heavy. | You should feel the upper and middle back, not the low back.
coach_hint: Main row from week 3 (Dumbbell Row before that). Balances all the pressing and punching.

name: Romanian Deadlift
current_title: STOP deadlifting until you learn how to do THIS/How To:Romanian DL
problems: "like closing a car door" is a stock cue; 7-min video
current_cue: Push hips back like closing a car door. This teaches the hip hinge pattern safely. Bar slides down your legs. Feel the stretch in your hamstrings, then squeeze glutes to stand.
proposed_title: How To Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
proposed_cue: Soft knees, push the hips back. Slide the bar down the thighs until the hamstrings stretch, then squeeze the glutes to stand.
proposed_tips: The bar stays touching the legs the whole way. | Stop where the back would start to round, usually just below the knee. | Slow down, normal speed up.
coach_hint: Fighter phase weeks 1-2 hinge, before Block Pull. Back today 2 or lower: glute bridges instead.

name: Block Pull
current_title: BLOCK PULL GUIDE | Form, Why Use Them, and More!
problems: Current video is "That Fit Friend", 8 min, unknown coach
current_cue: Same as conventional deadlift but bar starts elevated. This lets you practice pulling mechanics with less range. Ribs down, push the floor away. Build to full range.
proposed_title: The Block/Rack Pull: Untamed Special
proposed_cue: Bar on blocks just below the knee. Set up like a deadlift: bar over mid-foot, back flat, then push the floor away.
proposed_tips: Pull the slack out of the bar before it leaves the blocks. | Finish by standing tall, not leaning back. | Lower it to the blocks under control.
coach_hint: Main hinge from week 3 of Block Zero. Shorter range means less load on the low back while you build the pull.

name: Conventional Deadlift
current_title: How To Deadlift: Starting Strength 5 Step Deadlift
problems: "belt buckle to chin" is unclear; "You earned this progression" is filler
current_cue: Push the floor away. Don't think "pull the bar up." Ribs down, belt buckle to chin at lockout. Squeeze glutes at the top. You earned this progression.
proposed_title: Deadlift With PERFECT Form!
proposed_cue: Bar over mid-foot. Grip, shins to the bar, chest up to flatten the back. Push the floor away and stand tall.
proposed_tips: Keep the bar against the legs on the way up and down. | Lock out with glutes, not by leaning back. | Reset each rep if the back loses its position.
coach_hint: Fighter phase weeks 5-6, after RDL and Block Pull. Back today 2 or lower: glute bridges instead.

name: Incline DB Press
current_title: How To: Dumbbell Incline Chest Press
problems: ScottHermanFitness, generic gym channel; "builds a bigger chest" is hype
current_cue: Bench at 30 degrees. Pin shoulder blades back. This protects your shoulders and builds a bigger chest. Press up without letting shoulders roll forward.
proposed_title: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
proposed_cue: Bench at about 30 degrees. Lower the dumbbells to the upper chest, elbows a little in from the shoulders, then press up.
proposed_tips: Shoulder blades stay pinned to the bench. | Control the lowering, about 2 seconds.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase accessory. Upper-chest and shoulder volume without the barbell.

name: Lateral Raise
current_title: How To: Dumbbell Side Lateral Raise
problems: "builds wider shoulders" is hype
current_cue: Slight lean forward, lead with elbows. This targets the side delt and builds wider shoulders. Raise to shoulder height, control the descent. Light weight, high reps.
proposed_title: Fix Your Lateral Raise Form!💪🏼
proposed_cue: Light dumbbells. Raise out to the side to shoulder height, leading with the elbows, then lower slowly.
proposed_tips: Stop at shoulder height. | No swinging; if you have to swing, go lighter.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase accessory for the side of the shoulder. Light weight, higher reps.

name: EZ Bar Curl
current_title: How To: Inside-Grip Bicep Curl With E-Z Bar Curl
problems: Kept: on target and live; no shortlist source has a better EZ-bar demo
current_cue: Elbows pinned to your sides. This isolates the biceps and prevents cheating. Squeeze at the top, slow descent. The angled grip is easier on your wrists.
proposed_title: How To: Inside-Grip Bicep Curl With E-Z Bar Curl
proposed_cue: Elbows by your sides. Curl the bar up, squeeze, then lower it slowly to straight arms.
proposed_tips: The angled grip is easier on the wrists than a straight bar. | No swinging from the hips.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase arm work. Keep 2-3 reps in reserve.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
current_title: How To: Bulgarian Split Squat
problems: "knee stays over ankle" is outdated advice; "fixes side-to-side imbalances" over-claims
current_cue: Rear foot on bench, front foot far enough out that your knee stays over ankle. Lean slightly forward. This builds single-leg strength and fixes side-to-side imbalances.
proposed_title: The BEST Bulgarian Split Squat Tutorial
proposed_cue: Back foot on a bench, front foot far enough forward that you can sink straight down. Lower until the back knee nearly touches, then drive up through the front foot.
proposed_tips: A slight forward lean puts more work on the glute. | The front knee can go past the toes; that is fine. | Same reps each leg.
coach_hint: Single-leg work for kicking balance. Swapped for reverse lunges on a sore-back day.

name: Dumbbell Row
current_title: How to Perfect Your Dumbbell Row | Form Check | Men's Health
problems: Men's Health video, generic
current_cue: One hand and knee on bench. Pull to hip, not shoulder. This targets the lats more. Squeeze the shoulder blade back at the top. Each side independently.
proposed_title: Single Arm Dumbbell Bent Over Row
proposed_cue: One hand and knee on the bench, back flat. Pull the dumbbell toward the hip, pause, lower it all the way.
proposed_tips: Let the shoulder blade move forward at the bottom. | Do not twist the torso to lift it.
coach_hint: Main row in Block Zero weeks 1-2, and the sore-back swap for the barbell row.

name: Tricep Pushdown
current_title: How To: Tricep Pushdown (Life Fitness Cable)
problems: ScottHermanFitness, generic
current_cue: Elbows locked at your sides. This isolates the triceps. Squeeze at full extension. Control the return. Rope attachment gives the best range of motion.
proposed_title: Rope Triceps Pushdown
proposed_cue: Elbows pinned to your sides. Push the rope down until the arms are straight, spread the ends, then return slowly.
proposed_tips: Only the forearms move. | Lean a little forward if the shoulders want to help.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase arm work for lockout on presses and straight punches.

name: Hammer Curl
current_title: How To: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
problems: ScottHermanFitness, generic
current_cue: Neutral grip (palms face each other). This targets the brachioradialis and builds forearm strength for clinch work. Slow and controlled both directions.
proposed_title: Hammer Curl
proposed_cue: Palms facing each other. Curl the dumbbells up without swinging, lower slowly.
proposed_tips: Elbows stay by your sides. | Alternate arms or both together.
coach_hint: Forearm and grip work that carries over to the clinch.

name: Face Pulls
current_title: How To: Face Pull
problems: ScottHermanFitness, generic
current_cue: Rope at about face height. Pull toward your face with the elbows high, and turn the hands out so they finish beside the ears, pinkies back. Light and controlled. You should feel the back of the shoulders and between the shoulder blades. Trains the rear delts and rotator cuff.
proposed_title: Rope Face Pull
proposed_cue: Rope at face height. Pull toward the face with elbows high and turn the hands out so they end beside the ears.
proposed_tips: Light and controlled. | Feel the back of the shoulders and between the shoulder blades.
coach_hint: On every push and pull day. Shoulder health against all the pressing and punching.

name: Band Pull-Aparts
current_title: Do This EVERY SINGLE Day! (WORKOUT OR NOT)
problems: Current link is an ATHLEAN-X 7-min video titled "Do This EVERY SINGLE Day!", not a pull-apart demo; "wakes up the muscles" is filler
current_cue: Band at arm's length, pull apart until it touches your chest. This wakes up the muscles between your shoulder blades. High reps, every session warmup.
proposed_title: Banded Pull-Apart
proposed_cue: Band at shoulder height, arms straight. Pull it apart until it touches the chest, then let it back slowly.
proposed_tips: Shoulders stay down, away from the ears. | Use a light band for high reps.
coach_hint: Warm-up for strength days. Upper-back work you can do anywhere.

name: Pull-Up (Band Assisted)
current_title: How to do Banded Assisted Pull-Ups
problems: REP channel, 42-second product demo
current_cue: Full dead hang at bottom, chin clears bar at top. The band assists the hardest part. Pull with your lats, not just arms. Progress to thinner bands over time.
proposed_title: How to train pull-ups if you CAN'T DO 1 PULL-UP
proposed_cue: Band looped over the bar and under one knee or foot. Start from a dead hang, pull until the chin clears the bar, lower all the way.
proposed_tips: Pull the elbows down toward the ribs. | Use a thinner band as you get stronger.
coach_hint: Builds toward strict pull-ups for back and grip strength in the clinch.

name: Pull-Up (Negative)
current_title: How to do Banded Assisted Pull-Ups
problems: WRONG VIDEO: uses the band-assisted pull-up link
current_cue: Jump to top, lower yourself as slowly as possible. Aim for 5 seconds down. This builds the strength for real pull-ups faster than bands alone.
proposed_title: Eccentric Pull Up
proposed_cue: Jump or step to the top, chin over the bar. Lower yourself as slowly as you can, aim for 5 seconds, to a dead hang.
proposed_tips: Stop the set when you can no longer control the lowering. | Step back up; do not jump into the next rep.
coach_hint: Not in a template right now. A way to build pull-ups without a band.

name: Pull-Up
current_title: The Perfect Pull Up  - Do it right!
problems: Calisthenicmovement, generic
current_cue: Dead hang, shoulder-width grip. Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower under control to a full hang. You should feel the lats and upper back doing the work, not just the arms. Builds back and grip strength for clinch work.
proposed_title: How to Fix Problem Pull-Ups
proposed_cue: Dead hang, hands just wider than the shoulders. Pull until the chin clears the bar, then lower to a full hang.
proposed_tips: Start each rep by pulling the shoulders down. | No kipping or swinging.
coach_hint: Not in a template right now. The goal after the band and negatives.

name: Band Row
current_title: World Record Edition | Dude Perfect
problems: WRONG VIDEO: links to Dude Perfect "World Record Edition"
current_cue: Anchor the band under the feet or around a fixed post. Pull elbows back, pause, and keep ribs down.
proposed_title: Standing Banded Row
proposed_cue: Band anchored at chest height. Pull the elbows back past the ribs, pause, return slowly.
proposed_tips: Ribs down, no leaning back. | Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the end.
coach_hint: Home-day row when there is no gym.

name: Band Good Morning
current_title: Banded Good Morning
problems: Jenny LaBaw clip, generic
current_cue: Stand on the band with it behind the neck or shoulders. Push hips back, keep spine long, then squeeze glutes to stand.
proposed_title: Banded Good Morning - OPEX Exercise Library
proposed_cue: Stand on the band, loop it behind the neck. Soft knees, push the hips back with a long spine, then squeeze the glutes to stand.
proposed_tips: Go only as far as the back stays flat. | Light band; this is a hinge pattern, not a max.
coach_hint: Home-day hinge. Swapped for glute bridges on a sore-back day.

name: Band Chest Press
problems: DEAD LINK (video unavailable)
current_cue: Press the band forward from chest height. Keep shoulders down and ribs stacked.
proposed_title: Standing Band Press
proposed_cue: Band anchored behind you at chest height. Press straight forward, then let the hands come back slowly.
proposed_tips: Shoulders down, ribs stacked. | Staggered stance for balance.
coach_hint: Home-day press.

name: Band Curl
problems: DEAD LINK (video unavailable)
current_cue: Stand on the band, pin elbows near the ribs, curl without swinging.
proposed_title: Band Single Arm Biceps Curl
proposed_cue: Stand on the band, elbows by the ribs. Curl up without swinging, lower slowly.
proposed_tips: Shorten the band for more resistance.
coach_hint: Home-day arm work.

name: DB Bench Press
current_title: How To: Dumbbell Chest Press
problems: ScottHermanFitness, generic
current_cue: Set shoulder blades on the bench. Lower dumbbells under control, press without letting shoulders roll forward.
proposed_title: Dumbbell Bench Press
proposed_cue: Shoulder blades set on the bench. Lower the dumbbells beside the chest under control, then press up.
proposed_tips: Elbows a little in from the shoulders. | Feet flat on the floor.
coach_hint: Block Zero press when the barbell is not used, and a home-gym option.

name: Goblet Squat
current_title: How To: Goblet Squat
problems: ScottHermanFitness, generic; A main lift with a generic video
current_cue: Hold the weight high against the chest. Sit between the hips, keep torso tall, and drive through the floor.
proposed_title: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
proposed_cue: Hold the weight against the chest. Sit down between the hips with the chest tall, then stand through the whole foot.
proposed_tips: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom. | Go as deep as you can keep the back flat.
coach_hint: Main squat in Block Zero weeks 1-2, and the sore-back swap for the front squat.

name: DB Romanian Deadlift
current_title: How To: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
problems: ScottHermanFitness barbell RDL, wrong implement
current_cue: Dumbbells track down the legs. Hips move back, knees stay soft, spine stays long.
proposed_title: Dumbbells Romanian Deadlift | Lower Body Strength | Glutes & Hamstrings
proposed_cue: Dumbbells in front of the thighs. Soft knees, push the hips back, slide the weights down until the hamstrings stretch, then stand.
proposed_tips: Weights stay close to the legs. | Spine long the whole way.
coach_hint: Main hinge in Block Zero weeks 1-2. Teaches the pattern before the Block Pull.

name: DB Overhead Press
current_title: How To: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
problems: ScottHermanFitness, generic
current_cue: Brace ribs down. Press dumbbells overhead without leaning back.
proposed_title: Dumbbell Overhead Press
proposed_cue: Dumbbells at shoulder height. Brace, ribs down, press overhead without leaning back.
proposed_tips: A neutral grip (palms in) is kinder to sore shoulders. | Seated is fine.
coach_hint: Press in Block Zero, and the sore-back swap for the barbell press.

name: Lat Pulldown
current_title: How To: Lat Pulldown | 3 GOLDEN RULES
problems: ScottHermanFitness, 6 min
current_cue: Pull elbows down toward ribs. Chest tall, no swinging.
proposed_title: Stop Messing Up Your Lat Pulldowns
proposed_cue: Thighs under the pad. Pull the bar to the upper chest by driving the elbows down, then let it up slowly.
proposed_tips: Chest up, no swinging back. | Full stretch at the top.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase vertical pull. Builds toward pull-ups.

name: Hamstring Curl
current_title: How To: Prone Leg Curl (Cybex)
problems: ScottHermanFitness, generic
current_cue: Curl under control, pause, and return slowly without lifting the hips.
proposed_title: Seated Hamstring Curl with Cable Column
proposed_cue: Curl the pad down under control, pause, and return slowly. Hips stay on the seat.
proposed_tips: Slow on the way back, 2-3 seconds.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase hamstring work for kicking and sprint speed.

name: Push-Up
current_title: The Perfect Push Up | Do it right!
problems: Calisthenicmovement, generic
current_cue: Straight line from head to heels. Lower with control, press the floor away.
proposed_title: How To Perform A Proper PUSH-UP!
proposed_cue: Hands under the shoulders, body in one line. Lower the chest to just above the floor, then press it away.
proposed_tips: Elbows angled back, not flared out wide. | Raise the hands on a bench to make it easier.
coach_hint: Not in a template right now. A travel or home press.

name: Pike Push-Up
problems: DEAD LINK (video unavailable); No shortlist source; NASM is the fallback
current_cue: Hips high, head travels toward the floor between the hands. Press back up without collapsing the neck.
proposed_title: How to do a Pike Push-Up
proposed_cue: Hips high, hands shoulder width. Lower the head toward the floor between the hands, then press back up.
proposed_tips: Elbows go back, not out. | Feet on a box makes it harder.
coach_hint: Not in a template right now. A home overhead press.

name: Tempo Squat
current_title: Bowflex® How-To | Squats for Beginners
problems: Bowflex beginner squat video, generic
current_cue: Descend for three seconds, pause briefly, and stand with control.
proposed_title: Bodyweight Squat
proposed_cue: Lower for 3 seconds, pause briefly at the bottom, then stand under control.
proposed_tips: Count the 3 seconds out loud if it helps. | Hold a light band or weight to progress.
coach_hint: Home-day squat. The slow lowering makes light load count.

name: Reverse Lunge
current_title: Bowflex® How-To | Lunges for Beginners
problems: Bowflex beginner lunge video, generic
current_cue: Step back, keep front foot planted, and stand through the front leg.
proposed_title: Reverse Lunge
proposed_cue: Step one foot back and lower until the back knee nearly touches. Push through the front foot to stand.
proposed_tips: Most of the weight stays on the front leg. | Hold a wall for balance at first.
coach_hint: Single-leg work, and the sore-back swap for the Bulgarian split squat.

name: Single-Leg RDL
problems: DEAD LINK (video unavailable)
current_cue: Hinge on one leg with hips square. Reach long, then stand by squeezing the glute.
proposed_title: Master The Single Leg RDL (STRONG GLUTES!)
proposed_cue: Stand on one leg, soft knee. Hinge forward and reach the other leg back, hips square, then stand by squeezing the glute.
proposed_tips: Hold a wall or rack with one hand at first. | Toes of the back foot point down.
coach_hint: Home-day hinge and balance work for kicking.

name: Neck Isometrics (4-Way)
problems: No video
current_cue: Hand on the forehead, then the back of the head, then each side. Push into the hand and let nothing move. Hold each direction 10-20s at easy effort. Builds tolerance for clinch loading.
proposed_title: Neck Isometric Strengthening/Stabilizing
proposed_cue: Hand on the forehead, then the back of the head, then each side. Push into the hand and let nothing move. 10-20 seconds each way, easy effort.
proposed_tips: Breathe through the hold. | Never into pain.
coach_hint: Wednesdays once the muay thai ramp allows clinch. Builds neck tolerance for clinch work.

name: Wrist Curl
problems: No video
current_cue: Forearms on the thighs or a bench, palms up. Lower the weight to the fingertips, then curl the wrist up. Slow on the way down.
proposed_title: Weighted Wrist Flexion
proposed_cue: Forearm supported, palm up. Let the weight roll down to the fingertips, then curl the wrist up.
proposed_tips: Slow on the way down.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase grip and wrist work for the clinch and bag.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
problems: No video
current_cue: Forearms supported, palms down. Lift the back of the hand toward the ceiling, lower slowly. Light load. The extensors are smaller than the flexors.
proposed_title: Weighted Wrist Extension
proposed_cue: Forearm supported, palm down. Lift the back of the hand toward the ceiling, lower slowly.
proposed_tips: Use about half the wrist-curl weight.
coach_hint: Pairs with the wrist curl. Balances the forearm for punching.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
problems: No video
current_cue: Ball of one foot on a step, light hand on a wall. Full stretch at the bottom, rise as high as you can, lower for 2-3s. Same reps each side.
proposed_title: Single Leg Heel Raise
proposed_cue: Ball of one foot on a step, light hand on a wall. Full stretch at the bottom, rise as high as you can, lower for 2-3 seconds.
proposed_tips: Same reps each side. | Hold a dumbbell when 20 reps is easy.
coach_hint: Calf strength for running and footwork.

name: Tibialis Raise
problems: No video; Cue says "a foot out": short distances should read in inches
current_cue: Back against a wall, heels a foot out. Pull the toes up toward the shins as high as they go, lower slowly. Step the feet further out to make it harder.
proposed_title: Tibialis Wall Raises (Exercise Demo)
proposed_cue: Back against a wall, heels about 12 inches out. Pull the toes up toward the shins, lower slowly.
proposed_tips: Step the feet further out to make it harder.
coach_hint: Shin strength for running and checking kicks.

name: Trap-Bar Deadlift
problems: No video
current_cue: Stand in the middle of the bar, handles at the sides. Hips back, chest tall, push the floor away. The load stays in line with you, so the torso stays more upright than a straight-bar pull.
proposed_title: Trap Bar Deadlift
proposed_cue: Stand in the middle of the bar, handles at the sides. Hips back, chest tall, push the floor away.
proposed_tips: The torso stays more upright than in a straight-bar pull. | Stand tall at the top; no leaning back.
coach_hint: A back-friendly hinge when the gym has a trap bar.

name: Ab Wheel Roll-Out
current_title: Ab Wheel- How to PROPERLY Use an Ab Wheel | MIND PUMP
problems: "the highest EMG activation core exercise you can do" over-claims
current_cue: Squeeze glutes and brace hard. Roll out only as far as you can without your lower back dipping. This is the highest EMG activation core exercise you can do.
proposed_title: Ab Wheel Roll-Out: Correct Form Mistakes! #abs #technique
proposed_cue: From the knees, squeeze the glutes and brace. Roll out only as far as the low back stays flat, then pull back.
proposed_tips: Start with short rolls toward a wall. | Breathe out on the way back.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase core. Dead bugs replace it on a sore-back day.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
current_title: Hanging Leg Raise | HOW-TO
problems: ATHLEAN-X, 4.5 min; kept for now, no shortlist demo found; "Posterior pelvic tilt" is jargon
current_cue: Dead hang, raise legs to parallel without swinging. This forces your abs to work against gravity. Bend knees if straight legs are too hard. Posterior pelvic tilt at the top.
proposed_title: Hanging Leg Raise | HOW-TO
proposed_cue: Dead hang. Raise the legs to hip height without swinging, curling the pelvis up at the top. Bend the knees to make it easier.
proposed_tips: Lower slowly so the legs do not swing. | Knees bent is a fine version.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase core. Dead bugs replace it on a sore-back day.

name: Pallof Press
current_title: Standing Band Resisted Pallof Press
problems: "protects your spine during strikes and clinch" over-claims
current_cue: Stand sideways to cable, press hands straight out and resist the rotation. This builds the anti-rotation stability that protects your spine during strikes and clinch.
proposed_title: Standing Pallof Press with Shoulder Flexion
proposed_cue: Stand side-on to the band. Press the hands straight out and hold; do not let the band turn you.
proposed_tips: Feet shoulder width, glutes tight. | Step further from the anchor to make it harder.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase core. Trains the trunk to resist rotation.

name: Side Plank Hip Lift
current_title: Exercise Demo:  Side Plank Hip Lift
problems: Kept: live, on target, 20 s; "powers kicks and resists sweeps" over-claims
current_cue: Side plank on elbow, drop hip to floor and lift. This builds the lateral stability that powers kicks and resists sweeps. Each side independently.
proposed_title: Exercise Demo:  Side Plank Hip Lift
proposed_cue: Side plank on the elbow. Lower the hip toward the floor, then lift it back into line.
proposed_tips: Elbow under the shoulder. | Same reps each side.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase core for the sides of the trunk.

name: Body Saw
current_title: How To Do The Plank Body Saw Core Exercise
problems: "One of the highest-demand plank variations" is hype
current_cue: Forearm plank with feet on sliders, rock backward and forward. The further back, the harder. Keep ribs down and hips locked. One of the highest-demand plank variations.
proposed_title: Forearm Bodysaw with Sliders
proposed_cue: Forearm plank, feet on sliders. Rock the body back and forward a few inches with ribs down and hips level.
proposed_tips: The further back, the harder. | Stop when the hips sag.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase core. Dead bugs replace it on a sore-back day.

name: Cable Woodchop
current_title: How To: Oblique Twist "Wood Chopper" (LF CAble)
problems: Kept for now: on target; ScottHermanFitness; "builds the rotational power behind every strike" over-claims
current_cue: High-to-low or low-to-high. Rotate through your core, not your arms. Your hips and shoulders create the rotation. This builds the rotational power behind every strike.
proposed_title: How To: Oblique Twist "Wood Chopper" (LF CAble)
proposed_cue: Cable high and to one side. Pull it down and across the body, turning through the hips and trunk, arms long.
proposed_tips: The hips turn with the shoulders. | Control the return.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase rotational core.

name: Weighted Dead Bug
current_title: Dead Bug - Abdominal / Core Exercise Guide
problems: Bodybuilding.com, generic; "exactly like fighting" over-claims
current_cue: Hold a weight overhead, opposite arm and leg extend. Your lower back stays glued to the floor. This teaches your core to stabilize while your limbs move, exactly like fighting.
proposed_title: Dead Bug + Progression for Core Strength
proposed_cue: On your back, weight held over the chest, knees over hips. Reach one leg long while the low back stays down, then switch.
proposed_tips: Breathe out as the leg goes long. | If the back arches, shorten the reach.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase core, the loaded version of the dead bug.

name: Suitcase Carry
current_title: Killer Core Strength With One Simple Movement | Suitcase Carry Exercise Tutorial
problems: Buff Dudes, 4.5 min
current_cue: Heavy weight in one hand, walk tall without leaning. This builds the anti-lateral flexion strength that keeps you upright in the clinch. Switch sides each set.
proposed_title: Suitcase Carry
proposed_cue: Heavy weight in one hand. Walk tall without leaning toward it, then switch hands.
proposed_tips: Short steps, shoulders level.
coach_hint: Fighter-phase core. Trains the trunk to stay upright under a one-sided load.

name: Side Plank (Knees)
problems: No video
current_cue: Lie on your side, elbow under the shoulder, knees bent behind you. Lift the hips so knees, hips and shoulders line up. Breathe normally. Lower before the hips sag.
proposed_title: Short Lever Side Plank (Short Lever Isometric, Short Lever Supported)
proposed_cue: On your side, elbow under the shoulder, knees bent. Lift the hips so knees, hips and shoulders line up. Breathe normally.
proposed_tips: Lower before the hips sag.
coach_hint: Foundation levels 1-2. Side trunk endurance; the full side plank comes at level 3.

name: Side Plank
problems: No video
current_cue: Elbow under the shoulder, legs straight, feet stacked or staggered. Lift the hips into one straight line from head to heels. Breathe normally. Stop before the hips sag or the shoulder complains.
proposed_title: Side Plank
proposed_cue: Elbow under the shoulder, legs straight, feet stacked or staggered. Lift into one line from head to heels.
proposed_tips: Drop to the knees if the hips sag before the timer ends.
coach_hint: Foundation level 3. Part of the McGill-style trunk work.

name: McGill Curl-Up
problems: No video
current_cue: On your back, one knee bent, one leg straight, hands under the low back to keep its natural curve. Brace lightly and lift the head and shoulders about an inch as one unit. No chin tuck, no neck crank. Hold, then lower.
proposed_title: The McGill Big 3 (HOW TO DO IT CORRECTLY)
proposed_cue: One knee bent, one leg straight, hands under the low back. Lift the head and shoulders about an inch as one unit and hold.
proposed_tips: No chin tuck, no neck crank. | Swap the bent leg halfway.
coach_hint: Foundation back block, every morning. Trunk endurance without bending the spine.

name: Crocodile Breathing
current_title: Crocodile Breathing
problems: Kept: live and on target; no shortlist source
current_cue: Face down, forehead on your hands. Slow breaths into the low back and sides. A calm way to start; it eases tension rather than fixing anything.
proposed_title: Crocodile Breathing
proposed_cue: Face down, forehead on the hands. Breathe slowly into the low back and sides.
proposed_tips: About 4 seconds in, 6 out.
coach_hint: Opens Foundation every morning. Longer on a sore-back day.

name: Thoracic Extension on Foam Roller
current_title: Thoracic Extension Over Foam Roller | Relieve Upper Back Pain
problems: MobileWorkoutHouston, 1.3k views
current_cue: Roller across the upper back, hands behind the head. Let the upper back extend over the roller, ribs down, low back stays out of it. Try 2-3 spots. Builds upper-back extension range and feels good; it does not fix posture on its own.
proposed_title: Thoracic Extension over Foam Roller Head Supported | Spine Range of Motion
proposed_cue: Roller across the upper back, hands behind the head. Extend back over it with the ribs down, 3 slow reps at each of 2 spots.
proposed_tips: The low back stays out of it. | No roller: lean back over a chair back.
coach_hint: Foundation neck and shoulder block. Upper-back range for the guard and overhead work.

name: Prone Cobra
current_title: How To: Prone Cobra
problems: Kept: live and on target, Live Lean TV
current_cue: Lie face down, lift the chest and arms, thumbs up, shoulder blades back and down. Hold 3s. Trains the upper-back muscles.
proposed_title: How To: Prone Cobra
proposed_cue: Face down, arms by your sides. Lift the chest and turn the thumbs out, shoulder blades back and down. Hold 3 seconds.
proposed_tips: Look at the floor; keep the neck long.
coach_hint: Mobility session. Upper-back endurance.

name: Band External Rotations
current_title: Strengthen Your Rotator Cuff: Shoulder External Rotation with Mini Band
problems: Muscle & Motion, mini-band variation
current_cue: Elbow tucked to your side, rotate the forearm outward against the band. Slow. Trains the rotator cuff (infraspinatus and teres minor).
proposed_title: Standing Banded External Rotation (Neutral)
proposed_cue: Elbow at your side, a towel between elbow and ribs. Rotate the forearm out against the band, slowly back.
proposed_tips: Light band, 12-15 slow reps.
coach_hint: Foundation in the Fighter phase, not on push or pull days. Rotator cuff work for punching volume.

name: Couch Stretch
current_title: Couch Stretch for Tight Hips, Knee Pain & Low Back Relief | Dr. Kelly Starrett
problems: "Low back relief" title claims; otherwise fine
current_cue: Back foot on the couch, front knee forward, tuck the tailbone and squeeze the back glute. 30s each side. A strong hip flexor stretch; optional.
proposed_title: Half Kneeling Quad Stretch (Couch Stretch)
proposed_cue: Back knee on a pad, back foot up on a couch or wall. Tuck the tailbone and squeeze the back glute. 30 seconds each side.
proposed_tips: Start with the front knee forward and torso leaning; come upright as it eases.
coach_hint: Mobility session. Optional hip-flexor stretch after long sitting.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
current_title: The World's Greatest Stretch (Mobility Exercise) by Squat University
problems: Kept: Squat University, 43 s
current_cue: Lunge, hand inside front foot, rotate top arm to ceiling. 30s each side. Opens hip, groin, and thoracic spine in one move.
proposed_title: The World's Greatest Stretch (Mobility Exercise) by Squat University
proposed_cue: Long lunge, same-side hand down inside the front foot. Turn the top arm up to the ceiling and follow it with your eyes.
proposed_tips: Back knee down if you like. | 3 slow reps each side.
coach_hint: Foundation in the Fighter phase. Hip and upper-back range for kicks.

name: Ankle CARs
current_title: Functional Range Conditioning - Ankle CARs
problems: Melissa Ray Fitness, 9k views; "drives squat depth and kick mechanics" over-claims
current_cue: Controlled articular rotations. Slow full circles, both directions, each ankle. Dorsiflexion quality drives squat depth and kick mechanics.
proposed_title: Ankle CARs
proposed_cue: Lift the foot and draw the biggest slow circle you can with the ankle, both directions.
proposed_tips: Keep the shin still; only the foot moves.
coach_hint: Mobility session. Ankle range for squats and footwork.

name: Walking Knee Hugs
current_title: How to Do a Knee to Chest Stretch | Walking Knee Hugs Exercise Tutorial
problems: Your House Fitness, 1.9k views
current_cue: Step forward, lift one knee and hug it to your chest for a beat while standing tall on the other leg, then release and walk through. 6 per side. You should feel a stretch in the glute and back of the hugged leg. A dynamic hip warm-up.
proposed_title: Walking Knee Hugs
proposed_cue: Step, hug one knee to the chest for a beat while standing tall, then walk through. 6 per side.
proposed_tips: Rise onto the ball of the standing foot.
coach_hint: Not in a template since the static warm-up (migration 0019). Kept for reference.

name: Walking Quad Pulls
current_title: Dynamic Warmup Exercises | How to perform a Quad Stretch
problems: Kept: live, on target; "Lengthens rectus femoris" is jargon
current_cue: Step, grab same-side ankle behind you, squeeze glute for a beat, walk through. 6 per side. Lengthens rectus femoris on the move.
proposed_title: Dynamic Warmup Exercises | How to perform a Quad Stretch
proposed_cue: Step, pull the heel to the glute, squeeze that glute for a beat, walk through. 6 per side.
proposed_tips: Knees together.
coach_hint: Not in a template since migration 0019. Kept for reference.

name: Spiderman + T-Spine Rotation
current_title: Spider-Man Lunge w/ Thoracic Rotation
problems: Gabe Caldwell, 5k views; Duplicate of World's Greatest Stretch
current_cue: Low lunge, hand inside front foot, rotate top arm to ceiling and follow with your eyes. 5 per side. Hip, hamstring, and thoracic rotation in one.
proposed_title: Spider-Man Lunge w/ Thoracic Rotation
proposed_cue: Low lunge, hand inside the front foot, turn the top arm up and follow it with your eyes. 5 per side.
proposed_tips: Same move as the World's Greatest Stretch; consider merging the two.
coach_hint: Not in a template since migration 0019. Duplicate of the World's Greatest Stretch.

name: A-Skips
current_title: A Skip Running Drill
problems: Matt Holton, 6 min for a 20-second drill; Kept for now; no short shortlist demo found
current_cue: Light skip, drive lead knee to 90, opposite arm swings. 30s easy. Primes stride mechanics. Stay bouncy, not hard.
proposed_title: A Skip Running Drill
proposed_cue: Light skip. Drive one knee to hip height, opposite arm swings, land under the hips on the ball of the foot.
proposed_tips: Bouncy and quick, not high. | 2 x 20 yards.
coach_hint: Run-walk warm-up, once High-Knee March feels easy.

name: Lateral Lunges
current_title: Exercises with an Athletic Trainer: Lateral Lunge
problems: Children's Hospital Colorado clip; seed.sql and migration 0022 disagree (6 vs 8 per side; one has an em dash)
current_cue: Step wide, sit into one hip, other leg stays straight. 8 each side. Frontal-plane prep for running and kicking.
proposed_title: Bodyweight Lateral Lunge
proposed_cue: Step wide, sit back into one hip with the other leg straight. Push back to the middle. 8 each side.
proposed_tips: Both feet stay flat.
coach_hint: Not in a template since migration 0019. Kept for reference.

name: Hip Hinge Drill (Dowel)
problems: No video
current_cue: Hold a dowel or broom along your back, touching the head, upper back and tailbone. Soft knees. Push the hips back until you feel the hamstrings, keeping all three contact points. Stand by squeezing the glutes. Teaches the hinge without load.
proposed_title: Hip Hinge
proposed_cue: Dowel along the back touching head, upper back and tailbone. Soft knees, push the hips back until the hamstrings pull, keep all three contacts, then stand.
proposed_tips: If the dowel leaves the head or tailbone, the back has rounded or arched.
coach_hint: Foundation back block, not on hinge days. Teaches the hinge before RDLs and pulls.

name: Brisk Walk
problems: No video (none needed)
current_cue: Walk at a pace that raises your breathing but still lets you talk. Swing the arms. Warms the legs and back before the first run interval.
proposed_cue: Walk fast enough to raise your breathing while you can still talk. Swing the arms.
proposed_tips: 5 minutes before the first run interval.
coach_hint: First part of every run-walk. No video needed.

name: Leg Swings
problems: No video
current_cue: Hand on a wall or post. Swing one leg forward and back, small at first, a little bigger each swing. Stay tall, the swing comes from the hip, not the low back. Then side to side across the body.
proposed_title: Leg Swings (Flexion and Extension)
proposed_cue: Hand on a wall. Swing one leg forward and back, small at first and a little bigger each swing. Then side to side.
proposed_tips: The swing comes from the hip; the low back stays still.
coach_hint: Run-walk warm-up.

name: Ankle Rocks
problems: No video
current_cue: Staggered stance, hands on a wall. Bend the front knee forward over the toes and back, heel stays down. Smooth and controlled. Opens the ankle for the run.
proposed_title: Standing Knee to Wall
proposed_cue: Staggered stance, hands on a wall. Bend the front knee forward over the toes and back, heel down.
proposed_tips: Smooth, no bouncing.
coach_hint: Run-walk warm-up.

name: Standing Hip Circles
problems: No video
current_cue: Hands on hips or a wall. Lift one knee and draw a slow circle out to the side and back, then reverse. Keep the trunk still. Easy range, no forcing.
proposed_title: Hip Circles
proposed_cue: Hands on a wall. Lift one knee and draw a slow circle out to the side and back, then reverse.
proposed_tips: Trunk stays still.
coach_hint: Run-walk warm-up.

name: High-Knee March
problems: No video (none needed)
current_cue: March on the spot or forward. Drive one knee to hip height, opposite arm swings, rise onto the ball of the standing foot. Tall posture, ribs down. Progress to A-skips if it feels easy.
proposed_cue: March forward, driving one knee to hip height with the opposite arm. Rise onto the ball of the standing foot.
proposed_tips: Tall posture, ribs down. | Move on to A-skips when easy.
coach_hint: Run-walk warm-up. No video needed.

name: Foam Roll Pecs
current_title: Self Myofascial Release: Foam Rolling - Pectorals
problems: Video shows a foam roller; the cue says a ball on a wall; Kept for now: no shortlist ball demo found
current_cue: Ball against a wall, lean into the front of the chest. Roll slowly over tender spots and breathe. Short-term comfort and range, not a posture fix.
proposed_title: Self Myofascial Release: Foam Rolling - Pectorals
proposed_cue: Ball against a wall at the front of the chest. Lean in and roll slowly over tender spots, breathing.
proposed_tips: Stay off the armpit and collarbone.
coach_hint: Mobility session. Short-term comfort before the pec stretch.

name: Foam Roll Upper Traps
current_title: Foam Roller Drills for Neck Muscles (Fix Your Traps!)
problems: Criticalbench, 3.5 min, foam roller not ball
current_cue: Ball between the wall and the top of the shoulder, lean in and roll slowly with easy pressure. It can ease tension for a while; it does not change the muscle.
proposed_title: Levator and Upper Trap Release
proposed_cue: Ball between the wall and the top of the shoulder. Lean in with easy pressure and roll slowly.
proposed_tips: Easy pressure; it should feel like relief, not pain.
coach_hint: Not in a template right now. Optional on a stiff-neck day.

name: Foam Roll Hip Flexors
current_title: How to PROPERLY Foam Roll the Hip Flexors
problems: Kept for now: Criticalbench, on target; no shortlist demo
current_cue: Face down, roller on the front of the hip. Roll slowly from the hip crease to mid-thigh. Short-term comfort before a stretch.
proposed_title: How to PROPERLY Foam Roll the Hip Flexors
proposed_cue: Face down, roller just below the front of the hip. Roll slowly down to mid-thigh.
proposed_tips: Short-term comfort before a stretch.
coach_hint: Mobility session.

name: Doorway Pec Stretch
current_title: Stop Stretching Your Pecs Like This!
problems: 5-min Squat U video for a 30-second stretch
current_cue: Forearm on the door frame, elbow at or just above shoulder height. One side at a time. Step through gently until you feel the front of the chest, nothing sharp in the shoulder. Hold 30s and breathe.
proposed_title: Pec Stretch
proposed_cue: Forearm on the door frame, elbow at or just above shoulder height. Step through until you feel the front of the chest. 30 seconds each side.
proposed_tips: Nothing sharp in the shoulder. | Higher elbow stretches the lower chest.
coach_hint: Foundation neck block every morning.

name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
current_title: Hip Flexor Stretch - Done Correctly
problems: Sam Visnic video is 4 min
current_cue: Back knee down, squeeze that glute and tuck your tailbone under. You should feel a gentle stretch in the front of the back hip. Optional after long sitting; nice, not a back-pain fix.
proposed_title: Half Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
proposed_cue: Back knee down. Squeeze that glute and tuck the tailbone under until the front of the back hip stretches.
proposed_tips: Small move; do not lunge further forward.
coach_hint: Mobility session. Optional after long sitting.

name: Y-T-W Raises
current_title: How to Fix Scapular Winging (STEP BY STEP!)
problems: WRONG VIDEO: ATHLEAN-X "How to Fix Scapular Winging", 15 min
current_cue: Face down or bent over. Make Y, T and W shapes with the arms, thumbs up, shoulder blades back and down. Slow and light. Trains the middle and lower trapezius.
proposed_title: Prone Y's, T's, & I's
proposed_cue: Face down on a bench or the floor. Thumbs up, raise the arms into a Y, then a T, shoulder blades back and down.
proposed_tips: Slow and light; 1-2 lb is plenty. | Pause 1 second at the top.
coach_hint: Foundation neck block, not on strength days. Trains the middle and lower traps.

name: Chin Tucks
current_title: FIX Forward Head Posture! (Daily Corrective Routine)
problems: Jeremy Ethier "FIX Forward Head Posture!", 6 min; the "fix posture" claim contradicts the honest cues
current_cue: Start lying on your back, head on the floor or a folded towel. Nod gently, as if saying "yes", so the back of the neck lengthens. Not a hard double chin. Hold 10s, 10 times. Trains the deep neck flexors. Progress to sitting against a wall.
proposed_title: Reducing/preventing neck pain by strengthening the deep neck flexors
proposed_cue: Lying down, head on the floor or a folded towel. Nod gently as if saying yes, so the back of the neck lengthens. Hold 10 seconds.
proposed_tips: Not a hard double chin. | Level 2 adds a head lift of about an inch.
coach_hint: Foundation neck block every morning: 10 holds of 10 seconds, the dose used in neck-flexor trials.

name: Wall Angels
current_title: How to do the Wall Angel for tight shoulders
problems: [BackSpace] Chiropractic, "for tight shoulders"
current_cue: Back against the wall, arms in goalpost position. Slide up and down, and only go as high as you can keep contact with the wall. Gentle shoulder and upper-back range.
proposed_title: How to perform a wall angel to please your back
proposed_cue: Back against the wall, arms in a goalpost. Slide up and down only as high as you can keep contact.
proposed_tips: Ribs down; the low back stays near the wall.
coach_hint: Not in a template right now.

name: Glute Bridges
current_title: How To Properly Perform The Glute Bridge |#AskSquatU Show Ep. 39|
problems: Squat U video is 9 min
current_cue: Squeeze the glutes to lift, don't push through your lower back. Ribs down, tuck the tailbone slightly. Hold 2 seconds at the top. Builds hip extension strength.
proposed_title: Bridge
proposed_cue: On your back, feet flat. Squeeze the glutes to lift the hips, ribs down, pause 2 seconds at the top.
proposed_tips: Push through the heels, not the low back. | Level 3: single leg.
coach_hint: Foundation back block on non-strength days, and the sore-back swap for every hinge.

name: Dead Bugs
current_title: You're Doing Dead Bugs WRONG! Fix This for Stronger Abs & a Bulletproof Core
problems: Squat U video is 8.5 min
current_cue: Lower back pressed into the floor. Opposite arm and leg extend out. If your back arches, you went too far. This teaches your core to stabilize your spine during movement.
proposed_title: Dead Bug
proposed_cue: On your back, arms up, knees over hips. Reach one arm and the opposite leg long while the low back stays down.
proposed_tips: Breathe out as you reach. | If the back arches, shorten the reach.
coach_hint: Strength A core, and the swap for harder core work on a sore-back day.

name: Bird Dogs
current_title: How To PROPERLY Do The Bird Dog Exercise
problems: Mind Pump TV, 4 min; "powers rotational movement" over-claims
current_cue: On all fours, extend opposite arm and leg. Keep your hips level, don't rotate. This builds the cross-body stability that protects your spine and powers rotational movement.
proposed_title: Bird Dog
proposed_cue: On all fours. Reach one arm and the opposite leg long, hips level, hold, then switch.
proposed_tips: Reach long rather than high. | Level 3: make a fist with the reaching hand.
coach_hint: Foundation back block every morning.

name: Cat-Cow
current_title: Cat-Cow Yoga Pose - Yoga With Adriene
problems: Yoga With Adriene video is 9 min; "segmental movement through each vertebra" over-claims
current_cue: Arch up (cat), then drop belly and look up (cow). Move slowly with your breath. This warms up your entire spine and teaches segmental movement through each vertebra.
proposed_title: Global Cat Cow  | Spine Range of Motion | Flexion & Extension
proposed_cue: On all fours. Round the back up, then let it sag and look up, slowly with your breath.
proposed_tips: Only the range that feels easy.
coach_hint: Foundation back block every morning.

name: Pigeon Stretch
current_title: The BEST Hip Opener Stretch Ever Created
problems: Kept source changed to Tom Merrick (4 min) for a clearer setup
current_cue: Front leg bent across in front of you, back leg extended behind. Sink the hips down only as far as is comfortable and breathe. You should feel a stretch in the outside of the front hip and glute, nothing in the knee. Hold 45s each side. Don't force it.
proposed_title: Pigeon Stretch | Do It Right!
proposed_cue: Front leg bent across in front, back leg long behind. Sink the hips only as far as is comfortable. 45 seconds each side.
proposed_tips: Nothing in the knee. | A cushion under the front hip helps.
coach_hint: Mobility session and Zone 2 cool-down.

name: Cossack Squats
current_title: How to Cossack Squat Mobility Exercise: Tutorial & Progressions
problems: "you need for powerful kicks and low guards" over-claims
current_cue: Wide stance, shift to one side and sink deep. The other leg stays straight. This builds the hip mobility you need for powerful kicks and low guards.
proposed_title: Can't Do a Cossack Squat Yet? HERE'S HOW!
proposed_cue: Wide stance. Shift to one side and sit into that hip, the other leg straight with toes up. Push back to the middle.
proposed_tips: Hold a post if balance is the limit.
coach_hint: Mobility session. Side-to-side hip range for kicks and stance.

name: 90/90 Hip Switches
current_title: 90/90 Hip Switch (Improve Hip Health & Mobility)
problems: Simone Sports Performance; fine but not shortlist
current_cue: Sit with both legs bent at 90 degrees, one in front and one to the side. Rotate the knees over to switch sides, smooth and controlled, hands behind you if needed. You should feel the hips turning in and out, nothing pinching. Hip rotation range for kicks.
proposed_title: 90/90 Hip Transitions (Hands Supported)
proposed_cue: Sit with both legs bent at 90 degrees, one in front and one to the side. Rotate the knees over to switch sides, hands behind you.
proposed_tips: Smooth and controlled; nothing pinching.
coach_hint: Mobility session. Hip rotation for kicks.

name: Psoas March
current_title: Supine Psoas March
problems: Annie Miller, 935 views; Name says stretch but the move is a march
current_cue: On your back, band around the feet. Slow marching with the trunk braced, one knee toward the chest at a time. Hip flexor control and range.
proposed_title: Strengthening the Hip Flexors - Psoas March
proposed_cue: On your back, band around the feet. March one knee toward the chest against the band, trunk braced.
proposed_tips: Slow; the low back stays down.
coach_hint: Not in a template right now.

name: Wall Hip CARs
current_title: Controlled Articular Rotations (CARs) - Hips
problems: Kept: Tangelo chiropractor, live, on target; "translates to kicks" over-claims
current_cue: Hands on wall for balance. Lift knee high and rotate outward in the largest circle you can control, then reverse. This builds the usable hip range that translates to kicks.
proposed_title: Controlled Articular Rotations (CARs) - Hips
proposed_cue: Hand on a wall. Lift the knee and draw the biggest slow circle you can control, then reverse.
proposed_tips: Trunk stays still.
coach_hint: Not in a template right now.

name: Sciatic Nerve Glide
current_title: How to do Sciatic Nerve Flossing
problems: Kept for now: [BackSpace] Chiropractic "flossing"
current_cue: Seated, straighten one leg and gently rock the foot between pointed and flexed. Small, easy range, never into pain. If pain or tingling runs down the leg, stop and see a clinician.
proposed_title: How to do Sciatic Nerve Flossing
proposed_cue: Seated, straighten one leg and gently rock the foot between pointed and flexed. Small, easy range.
proposed_tips: If pain or tingling runs down the leg, stop and see a clinician.
coach_hint: Not in a template right now.

name: Toe-Touch Forward Fold
current_title: Beginners Yoga How To Forward Fold - How To Touch Your Toes | Yoga Hamstring Stretch
problems: Yoga for BJJ, 4 min; "Full posterior chain opens in one move" over-claims
current_cue: Feet hip-width, fold from the hips, let the head hang. Soft knees if the hamstrings grip. 45s. Full posterior chain opens in one move.
proposed_title: Beginners Yoga How To Forward Fold - How To Touch Your Toes | Yoga Hamstring Stretch
proposed_cue: Feet hip width. Fold from the hips and let the head hang. Soft knees if the hamstrings grip. 45 seconds.
proposed_tips: Breathe out to sink a little further.
coach_hint: Zone 2 pre-run stretch set.

name: Butterfly Stretch
current_title: Groin Stretch and Strengthening (Butterfly)
problems: Markow Training, 4 min, 8k views
current_cue: Sit with the soles of the feet together and let the knees fall open. Sit tall, then fold forward gently from the hips. You should feel a stretch along the inner thighs. 60s, breathing easy.
proposed_title: BUTTERFLY STRETCH
proposed_cue: Soles of the feet together, knees falling open. Sit tall, then fold forward gently from the hips. 60 seconds.
proposed_tips: Hands on the ankles, not pushing the knees.
coach_hint: Zone 2 pre-run stretch set.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
current_title: How to Stretch your Hip Flexors (Quads/Psoas) with Antranik (Part 1)
problems: WRONG VIDEO: Antranik hip-flexor stretch part 1, not a standing quad stretch
current_cue: Stand tall, a hand on a wall if needed. Grab the ankle behind you, knees together, and squeeze the back glute. You should feel a stretch in the front of the thigh and hip. 30s each side.
proposed_title: Standing Quad Stretch
proposed_cue: Stand tall, hand on a wall. Hold the ankle behind you, knees together, squeeze the back glute. 30 seconds each side.
proposed_tips: Do not arch the low back to get the foot higher.
coach_hint: Zone 2 pre-run stretch set.

name: Standing Calf Stretch
current_title: Standing Wall Calf Stretch
problems: "the chain that takes every step of impact" is filler
current_cue: Hands on wall, back leg straight, press the heel down. 30s each side. Gastrocnemius and Achilles, the chain that takes every step of impact.
proposed_title: Standing Calf Stretch (Knee Straight)
proposed_cue: Hands on a wall, back leg straight, heel down. Lean in until the calf stretches. 30 seconds each side, then repeat with the knee bent.
proposed_tips: Back toes point straight ahead.
coach_hint: Zone 2 pre-run stretch set.

name: Shoulder Rolls
problems: No video (none needed)
current_cue: Stand or sit tall. Slowly roll the shoulders up, back and down. Easy range, nothing that pinches. A gentle option on a sore-neck day.
proposed_cue: Stand or sit tall. Slowly roll the shoulders up, back and down. Easy range, nothing that pinches.
proposed_tips: 10 slow rolls.
coach_hint: Foundation on a bad-neck day only. No video needed.

name: Jab → Cross
problems: No video (combos have no video field); "Power comes from the ground, not the arm" is a slogan
current_cue: Rotate the hip fully on the cross. Power comes from the ground, not the arm.

proposed_cue: CUE flap: EYES FIRST
